contexts.text: That evils of life are not to be followed. Signified.

The reason he has no faith, is that he is in evil of life; and evil of life and the truth of faith can never act as one; the evil of life destroys the truth of faith; because the evil of life is of the will... and the will leads the understanding...
For the evil of life interiorly hates truths.
All the good of life is from the action of God; and all the evil of life is from the reaction of man...
Saying, that all things with them are holy from the Lord, and so are the evils of life, by their not being attended to.

The wild beasts of the earth = evils of life, which are the cupidities and the falsities thence originating from the love of self and the world... (and which) lay waste the Church with man. Explained.
They who teach falsities, and thereby lead to the evil of life. Signified.
